about: Vancouver is British Columbia’s largest city, on Burrard Inlet between the Pacific and the North Shore mountains. It is a Pacific Rim port with a dense downtown peninsula of apartments, parks, and seawalls. The city proper is relatively small; most of the metro area lies in surrounding municipalities. About 660,000 people live in Vancouver itself.
seoSummary: B.C.’s largest city, a Pacific port between mountains and the ocean.
knownFor: Large East and South Asian communities
